{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")"}
